statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat without a clear precipitating factor.
The symptoms are non-sustained in nature.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary.
The service is for capturing potential arrhythmic events over a prolonged monitoring period.
The diagnosis code I49.9 is associated with this claim.
The diagnosis code R00.2 is associated with this claim.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was due to lack of required precertification or prior authorization.
